sourceFacts: The cab has a 7-inch high-resolution multifunction monitor and a multifunction controller.
The controller selects and adjusts menu items including maintenance support, attachment flow and optional rear-view monitor functions.

sourceFacts.fact: The monitor is not a single picture: the manual enumerates six menus, thirteen submenus, and sixteen fields on the basic screen.
ACC/ON starts a roughly two-second startup state; ACC shows hour, clock and radio, while ON enters the basic screen; the alternator alarm persists until generation begins.
The optional password flow has a three-failure buzzer state and configurable validity duration.
Alarm List exists in the main menu only when a current alarm exists and lists only current alarms.
Auto Shut-Down has a timed warning, buzzer phases, idle reduction, stop transition and a pilot-lever abort condition.
Rear-view camera monitoring is optional; when enabled its image is continuously shown on the basic screen and remains only an aid.
With rear camera off, the under-meter area can be OFF, Logo or Operation Information.
Information contains Operation, Maintenance and Monitoring with resettable hours, maintenance notice/interval behavior and engine-speed monitoring.
The physical switch panel defines controller actions and state-changing switches; ECO is the engine-start default and work lights cause night mode.
Return-previous, return-basic and selector-knob input types are distinct: selector push opens/confirms while rotate moves the cursor.
Brightness adjustment requires an ordered selector path; clockwise brightens and counterclockwise darkens; day and night brightness are independently adjustable.
Work-light position 2 enters monitor night mode with the night mark; numeric key 0 can activate the daytime screen while lights remain on.
The selected passage does not explicitly bind monitor mode for work-light position 1 or OFF; those transitions remain UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

boundaries: The fixture probe validates contract semantics, not the production LCD implementation.
Pages after 129 were not required for this bounded trial and remain unread in this round.

No Mother branch, production asset, main branch or R2 gate is modified.
